definitions.explanation: Describes something that evokes a sense of horror, dread, or the uncanny. Often used for atmospheres, appearances, sounds, or artistic styles that are intentionally creepy or macabre.

examples.japanese: おどろおどろしい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧だ。
おどろおどろしい⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧きた。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、おどろおどろしい⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれていて→描く：02013_egaku⟧、⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{怖|こわ}く→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The movie poster has such a ghastly illustration that just looking at it is scary.

notes:
An emphatic reduplicative form related to ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧ (frightening). The repetition of the おどろ element intensifies the sense of horror and eeriness. Written entirely in hiragana; no standard kanji form is in common use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おどろおどろしい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: eerie atmosphere
- おどろおどろしい⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: ghastly voice
- おどろおどろしい⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: creepy sound
- おどろおどろしい⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧: gruesome painting/illustration
- おどろおどろしい⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧: sensational/lurid title

USAGE:
Often used to describe horror media (movies, books, artwork), haunted house atmospheres, or anything deliberately designed to evoke dread. Can also be used critically to describe something overly melodramatic or exaggeratedly horrifying.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧: frightening; terrifying — a general term for fear, broader in application
- ⟦{不気味|ぶきみ}→不気味：16040_bukimi⟧: uncanny; creepy — focuses on the unsettling quality of something that feels "off"
- ⟦{気味|きみ}が{悪|わる}い→気味が悪い：22680_kimigawarui⟧: creepy; gives one the creeps — a more colloquial way to express unease
- ⟦おぞましい→おぞましい：07932_ozomashii⟧: hideous; revolting — emphasizes disgust and moral repulsion more than supernatural dread
